query:
SELECT 
  b.id as book_id,
  b.title,
  b.authorId,
  b.createdAt,
  b.updatedAt,
  b.workflowStep
FROM books b
JOIN authors a ON b.authorId = a.id
JOIN users u ON a.userId = u.id
WHERE u.email = 'paulinet77@gmail.com'
ORDER BY b.title, b.createdAt;
